obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: The candidate screen prunes before any question is asked: 9 oracle questions settled all 8 splittable bugs across 51.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The partition and the elimination rule are domain-neutral: they apply to any finite hypothesis set whose behaviours can be observed, not just to program repair.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Majority vote was measured wrong 3 of 5 times; a bigger budget cannot split survivors that already pass every test; minimax is the wrong objective when the oracle is known correct; a model is prohibited producer cognition.
